text.en: A cloud is our roof, our beauty and our messenger.

Megam is a new poem (புதுக்கவிதை) by Nagore Rumi. It says that the cloud is our roof and adorns the sky. Bharathi described the evening clouds beautifully, even forgetting metre, and poets have made the cloud a messenger, as in Kalidasa's Meghasandesham.
The poem delights in the cloud's beauty and its role in bringing rain. It shows that nature inspires poets.
Terms: மேகம் (cloud), புதுக்கவிதை (free verse), தூது (messenger) and அழகு (beauty).
